name: line
description: One log pattern (template) with its sender, frequency and context, as an operator scanning the logs would see it.

odd.instructions: Would an experienced network operator watching these logs think 'that is strange, someone should look at this'?

kind.instructions: What kind of log line is this?

criteria.state_change: a session, link, peer or service went up or down
criteria.noise: routine chatter nobody needs to read

team.instructions: Which team owns what this line is about?

criteria.l2l3: switches, routers, BGP, VyOS, links and upstreams
criteria.server: Kubernetes, Kea DHCP server, Unbound DNS, NTP, syslog and other servers
criteria.wifi: access points and the wireless controller
